select * from ( SELECT w.id, w.level, w.event_desc eventDesc, DATE_FORMAT( w.event_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) eventTime, w.event_bussi eventBussi, w.user_id userId, w.user_name userName, w.deal_status dealStatus, w.deal_result dealResult, DATE_FORMAT( w.deal_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) dealTime, w.deal_user_id dealUserId, w.is_msg isMsg, d.code_name dealResultDesc, csu.user_name dealUserName FROM comm_system_bussi_event_warning w LEFT JOIN comm_base_code_detail d ON w.deal_result = d.code_id AND d.type_no = 'SYS201' LEFT JOIN comm_system_user csu ON w.deal_user_id = csu.user_id ) temp where 1=1
and ${key} like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
order by ${column} ${order}
order by id desc
